text:
maria: hey all ":wave:" i'm oncall next week (first rotation). quick: who's my week-1 buddy, how do i run a one-off pager test, and is there a tiny 'first-shift' checklist i can skim tonight? trying to avoid surprises.
dan: welcome! i'm your week-1 buddy. add me on PagerDuty (dan@redwood.com). i'll shadow your first shift and do the handoff.
owen: for a local test (VPN + SSO) run: ```curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/test_alert -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"user":"maria"}'``` OpsBot will enqueue a sim. if you see 403 check PD role and ~/.redwood/credentials.
maria: ran the curl and got 403, SSO OK.
dan: 403 usually missing the oncall-rotator role, owent can you grant? also confirm phone has push+SMS.
owen: granted role and synced contacts. try again.
opsbot: OpsBot: test queued for maria; delivering in ~20s.
maria: got push "TEST ALERT - SIM". PD shows source ops-sim. thanks!
dan: checklist: 1) verify PD contact methods 2) run sim 3) join 30m dry-run tomorrow 10am PT 4) review triage cheatsheet (links in DM). ack windows: 5m P1 day, 10m nights/weekends.
maria: perfect, joining the dry-run. feeling better already :relieved:
